desc:
✈️ The captain fell asleep. Can you land the plane?
Made by the creators of "Can You Pass A Driving Test?"

🛬 Land the jet → earn your Student Permit
💰 Do flying jobs → earn cash
🪪 Pass flight tests → get new licenses
🏆 Work up to the best plane in the sky

What you can do:
🏝️ Fly between islands with a co-pilot and ATC guiding you
📦 Haul cargo, carry passengers, dust crops and fly rescues
🌧️ Take on crosswinds, storms and night landings
🎨 Paint your plane with new liveries
📱 Play on all devices

Fly safe! 👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
